evidence: The HfO2 films were deposited on p-type Si (100) wafers at 340 °C by the PEALD method using O2 or N2O plasma with tetrakis-diethyl-amino-hafnium (Hf(NC2H5)4), as the Hf precursor. The sequential processing time for the Hf(NC2H5)4, Ar purge, plasma, and Ar purge were 5, 7, 5, and 7 s, respectively.
